senses.zh_definition: Camille：一个人名，常见于法语，可用于男性或女性；中文音译可作“卡米耶”，应以本人采用的译名为准。
senses.en_definition: A given name used for both men and women in French; its pronunciation may vary by language and bearer.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang digunakan sebagai nama lelaki atau perempuan dalam bahasa Perancis.
senses.nuances: 通常应大写为 Camille。数据包没有 DBP 释义，无法据此核实其马来语普通词身份，故不标为 official；此处马来语释义是专名说明，并非 DBP 官方释义。以下组合是姓名使用示例，不声称为经过频率验证的固定搭配。[姓名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/camille), [法语读音](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/Camille)

etymology.historical_story: Camille is a French form associated with the Latin names Camillus and Camilla. Its deeper origin is uncertain: the familiar explanation connecting it with a young religious attendant is not universally accepted. French uses Camille for both sexes, so neither the spelling nor the name alone establishes the bearer's gender. [Camille](https://www.behindthename.com/name/camille), [Camillus](https://www.behindthename.com/name/camillus)
